source: Chapter 706: The Utility of Delicacies
target: Capitulum 706: Utilitas Deliciarum

source: In another apartment on Rue Orosay in the Quartier de la Cathedrale Commemorative, Lumian placed the cold Furth fish in front of Ludwig.
target: In alia habitatione in via Orosay in Quartiere Cathedrale Commemorative, Lumian piscem Furth frigidum coram Ludovico posuit.

source: Ludwig’s eyes lit up when he saw the pan‐fried fish in the exquisite wooden box.
target: Oculi Ludovici fulserunt cum piscem sartum in arca lignea exquisita conspexit.

source: He quickly turned to Lugano, who understood his meaning and handed over a child’s knife and fork he had found in the newly rented room.
target: Celeriter se vertit ad Lugano, qui sensum eius intellexit et tradidit puerilem cultrum atque furcam, quas in nuper conducto conclavi inveniret.

source: Lumian leaned back in his chair and watched as Ludwig sliced the remaining half of the fish into pieces, chewing and swallowing the meat along with the bones.
target: Lumian in sella sua recubuit et spectavit, dum Ludovicus dimidium piscis reliquum in frusta secabat, carnem ossibus simul masticans et deglutens.

source: Without waiting for Lumian to inquire, Ludwig narrowed his eyes, seemingly enjoying himself, and said, “The Forth Firefish is a mutated fish resulting from the corruption leaking from Fourth Epoch Trier.
target: Sine exspectatione, ut Lumian interrogaret, Ludovicus oculos contraxit, quasi sibi ipsi delectaretur, et dixit: “Piscis Ignifer Forthus est piscis mutatus, ortus ex corruptione effusae ex Aetate Quarta Trier.

source: Its breed stabilized 769 years ago and mainly resides in the Danro section of the underground Madar River.
target: Species eius ante 769 annos stabilita est et praesertim in regione Danro fluminis subterranei Madar habitat.

source: Its meat and blood can be concocted into a “warm cocktail” with various sunflowers.
target: Caro eius et sanguis in mixturam calidam cum variis helianthorum componi possunt.

source: After drinking it, one can resist the effects of the cold to a certain extent for half an hour.
target: Postquam id biberit, quisdam effectibus frigoris ad aliquam modum per dimidiam horam resistere potest.

source: “A Furth Firefish that has lived for over a decade is an ingredient rich in spirituality.
target: Piscis Ignifer Furth, qui plus quam decem annos vixerit, est elementum spiritualitate dives.

source: Using its meat, blood from a Mid-Sequence Beyonder of the Hunter pathway, ice, and lemon juice, one can cook Ice Lemon Fish fillets.
target: Uti carne eius, sanguine a Beyonder Medio-Sequenti viae Venatoris, glacie, et succo citri, fileta Piscis Ice Lemon coqui possunt.

source: After anyone eats them for the first time, they permanently enjoy reduced damage from flames.
target: Postquam ea quisquam primum edit, damna ignis in perpetuum minuantur.

source: Eating them later will enhance the effect, but it only lasts for half an hour.
target: Postea edendo effectus augebitur, sed tantum per dimidiam horam permanet.

source: Lumian nodded in enlightenment.
target: Lumian in sapientia caput annuit.

source: In Franca’s words, the first time its eaten, it adds some permanent fire resistance.
target: Secundum verba Francae, ea primum edenda, addit aliquam permanentem ignis repugnantiam.

source: The subsequent enhancements are temporary…
target: Subsequentes emendationes sunt temporariae…

source: Lugano was taken aback.
target: Lugano obstupefactus est.

source: Ludwig actually knows cooking?
target: Revera Ludovicus artem coquinariae novit?

source: Moreover, it involves cooking with superpowers!
target: Praeterea, hoc implicat coquinam utens virtutibus supernaturales.

source: Can 1 help him get ingredients rich in spirituality and have him make similar delicacies for me?
target: Potesne mihi adiuvare, ut ei ingredimenta spiritualitate dives comparare possit et pro me similes delicatias praeparare?

source: It seems capable of permanently enhancing some of my abilities!
target: Videtur posse aliquas facultates meas permanentiter auget.

source: After Ludwig finished his meal, Lumian suddenly thought of something.
target: Postquam Ludovicus cenam finivit, Lumian subito aliquid cogitavit.

source: Franca’s ritual for advancing to the Demoness of Affliction involved being burned at the stake—without using a substitute—for fifteen minutes and surviving without going mad.
target: Ritualis Francae ad Demoness Afflictionis ascendentem consistit in comburendo ad supplicium per quindecim minuta, sine substituto, et superstes manere sine insanire.

source: If Franca eats Furth Firefish’s Ice Lemon Fish fillet to increase her fire resistance, although the pain won’t abate, her chances of surviving the incineration will greatly increase.
target: Si Franca filetan Piscis Ice Lemon Furth edit, ad augendam ignis repugnantiam, quamquam dolor non remittetur, probabilitas eius incinerationem superandi multum augescet.

source: When the time comes, she can eat some more temporarily before the ritual.
target: Cum tempus adveniet, paulo amplius ante ritum edere potest.

source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he quickly made up his mind.
target: Lumiani cogitationes celeriter volaverunt, dum mox mentem suam constanter firmavit.

source: Today, he would head to Underground Trier to search for Fiirth Firefish that had lived for over a decade!
target: Hodie, ad Trier subterraneum se diriget ut piscem Furth Ignifer, qui plus quam decem annos vixerit, quaerat!

source: From his Traveler’s Bag, Lumian retrieved a map of Underground Trier reconstructed from his memories, derived from the one Gardner Martin had once displayed.
target: Ex sacculo Viatoris suo, Lumian mappam Trier subterraneum ex memoriis suis reconstructam evexit, quae a Gardner Martin olim ostensa erat.

source: He searched for the location of the Danro section of the Madar underground river.
target: Locum partis Danro fluminis subterranei Madar investigavit.

source: As Lumian scrutinized the map, he asked Ludwig with a smile, “How do you know the precise name of the source? Do Furth Firefish have knowledge of the rivers they inhabit?”
target: Dum Lumian mappam diligenter examinabat, Ludovico risu quaesivit: “Quomodo scis praecisum nomen fontis? Habentne Piscēs Furth Ignifer scientiam de fluminibus quibus habitant?”

source: Ludwig licked his lips, unsatisfied.
target: Ludovicus labra lambit, non contentus.

source: “Indeed, they do. From years of fishing, humans inevitably mention the names of rivers and specific sections. Even if Furth Firefish don’t comprehend the meaning, they instinctively retain this information in their corresponding cells when repeatedly exposed to it.”
target: “Revera, ita est. Ex annis piscandi, homines necessario nomina fluminum et specificas partes memorant. Etiam si Piscēs Furth Ignifer significatum non capiunt, instinctive hanc notitiam in cellulis suis retinent.”

source: “Interesting.” Lumian had posed the question in jest, not anticipating such a serious response.
target: “Interes.” Lumian quaestionem iocose proposuerat, non praevidens talem responsionem gravem.

source: Pointing to himself, he inquired curiously, “Will consuming the Ice Lemon Fish fillet reduce the burn damage I sustain?”
target: Indicans se, curiosus quaesivit: “Num edendo filetum Piscis Ice Lemon damna combustionis, quae mihi inferuntur, minuantur?”

source: As a Reaper, flames inflict relatively minimal damage to him.
target: Ut Messor, flammae damna parva ei infligunt.

source: Ludwig picked up a minuscule remnant of the fish, no larger than a grain of rice, from the exquisite wooden box and presented it to Lumian.
target: Ludovicus ex arca lignea exquisita remnantem minutum piscis, non majus quam granum oryzae, sustulit et Lumiano tradidit.

source: “Only this much.”
target: “Tantum hoc.”

source: Without hesitation, the boy promptly popped the morsel into his mouth.
target: Sine mora, puer statim rem in os suum introduxit.

source: “Well, that’s better than nothing,” Lumian remarked with a smile and a sigh.
target: “Atque hoc melius est quam nihil,” Lumian cum risu et suspirio dixit.

source: He intended to secure a special serving of Ice Lemon Fish fillet for himself, with additional portions for Jenna, Anthony, Lugano, and Ludwig!
target: Intendebat sibi propriam portionem fileti Piscis Ice Lemon obtinere, itemque partes additas pro Jenna, Anthony, Lugano, atque Ludovico!

source: To accomplish this task, Lumian proactively inquired, “How does a Furth Firefish that has lived for over a decade differ from its ordinary counterparts?”
target: Ad hoc perficiendum, Lumian proactivus quaesivit: “Quomodo differat Piscis Ignifer Furth, qui plus quam decem annos vixerit, ab ordinariis suis?”

source: Ludwig’s response sounded as if he were reciting from a textbook, “A Furth Firefish that has survived for more than a decade can grow to nearly a meter in length and tends to reside in caves at the riverbed. They rarely approach the surface but exhibit a keen sensitivity to blood and spiritually rich food. These fish are highly aggressive and willing to take significant risks driven by their instincts.”
target: Ludovicus respondit quasi ex testo: “Piscis Ignifer Furth, qui ultra decem annos superfuit, ad fere metrum crescere potest et in speluncis iuxta ripas fluminis habitare solet. Raro enim ad superficiem accedunt, sed acutam sensibilitatem erga sanguinem atque cibos spiritualiter dives ostendunt. Hi piscēs sunt vehementer aggressivi et pericula significantia, instinctibus impellentia, subire volunt.”

source: “Their skin has hardened, rendering them impervious to fishing spears.
target: Pellis eorum durata est, ita ut telis piscandi invulnerabiles sint.

source: Sharp teeth fill their mouths, enabling them to devour any humans who happen to fall into the river.
target: Dentes acuti ora eorum implet, quae eos facit ut homines, qui in flumen cadant, devorare possint.

source: Additionally, their blood possesses a distinct burning characteristic.
target: Praeterea, sanguis eorum proprietatem ignis distinctam exhibet.

source: After attentively listening, Lumian calmly assessed the information.
target: Postquam attente audivit, Lumian informationem tranquillē perpendit.

source: Despite their longevity of over a decade, Furth Firefish did not possess Beyonder characteristics or acquire supernatural abilities through boons.
target: Quamquam ultra decem annos vixerunt, Piscēs Furth Ignifer proprietates Beyonder non habebant nec facultates supernaturales per dona acceperunt.

source: They belonged to a species that had undergone corruption but had since stabilized.
target: Ad speciem pertinebant quae corruptionem passa erat, sed postea stabilita est.

source: If they were to continue living in such an environment for tens of thousands of years, they might evolve into creatures with their own intricate society, akin to the Batings Black Insect.
target: Si in tali ambitu per decem milia annorum vixerent, evolvere possent in creaturas cum propria intricata societate, similes “Batings Black Insect.”

source: As he put away the map and stood up, Lumian turned to Ludwig and asked thoughtfully before leaving,
target: Cum mappam recondidisset et surrexisset, Lumian ad Ludovicum conversus, antequam discessit, cogitato quaesivit:

source: “Apart from the permanent enhancements, does this special cooking method involve any adverse effects, such as corruption?”
target: “Praeter augmentationes permanentes, num haec methodus specialis coquendi aliquos effectus adversos, sicut corruptionem, includit?”

source: Ludwig scrutinized Lumian and remained silent. Lumian suspected that Ludwig was internally mocking him.
target: Ludovicus Lumian percontatus tacuit; Lumian suspicabatur Ludovicum intus eum deridere.

source: For someone already deeply corrupted, the concern over a minuscule amount of additional corruption seemed trivial.
target: Nam, cum aliquis iam alte corruptus esset, sollicitudo de parva quantitate corruptionis addita trivialis videbatur.

source: After a brief pause, Ludwig replied, “As a child, I lack understanding of such matters. What I do know is that if one desires to indulge in finer and more delectable cuisine, they must be willing to accept the associated risks. Those unwilling to take the risk can simply choose not to partake…”
target: Post breve silentium, Ludovicus respondit: “Ut puer, huiusmodi rebus intellectum mihi defuit. Quod autem scio est, si quis exquisitiorem et sapidoriorem escam petat, pericula consociata suscipere debet. Qui periculum non capere volunt, simpliciter recusare possunt…”

source: Ludwig instinctively added, “If you don’t wish to eat, you can always leave the food for me.”
target: Ludovicus instinctu addidit: “Si non vis edere, cibum mihi relinquere potes.”

source: With a slight nod, Lumian opened the door and exited the apartment.
target: Levis annuit, Lumian ianuam aperuit et ex habitatione discessit.

source: In the depths of Underground Trier, the Madar River flowed through a tranquil, deserted, and dimly lit cave, its gentle splashing echoing in the distance.
target: In profunda Trier subterraneum, flumen Madar per speluncam quietam, desertam, et parve luminatam fluebat, eius lenis strepitus in longinquo resonans.

source: Emerging from the shadows, Lumian, Franca, and Jenna made their way to the riverbank.
target: Emergentes ex umbris, Lumian, Franca, et Jenna ad ripam fluminis accesserunt.

source: One carried a carbide lamp, while the other two traveled empty-handed.
target: Unus lampadem carbidae gerebat, dum duo ceteri sine muneribus iter faciebant.

source: Although ingredient suppliers seeking to monopolize Furth Firefish guarded this section of the subterranean river, it posed no significant challenge for a Hunter and two Demonesses.
target: Quamquam venditores ingredientorum, cupientes Piscem Furth Ignifer monopolizare, hanc partem fluminis subterranei custodiabant, id nihil momenti pro Venatore et duabus Demonessibus repraesentabat.

source: Utilizing the shadows, they deftly navigated through the patrolled area and successfully reached the water’s edge.
target: Utendo umbris, arte per regionem custoditam navigaverunt et feliciter ripam aquae attigerunt.

source: Raising his carbide lamp, Lumian discovered that the underground river was not only expansive but also incredibly deep.
target: Levans lampadem carbidae, Lumian invenit flumen subterraneum non solum spatiosum esse, sed etiam incredibiliter profundum.

source: Submerged caves lined the riverbed, inhabited by peculiar fish.
target: Speluncae submersae fluminis fundo erant, et in eis piscēs peculiares habitabant.

source: After a quick survey, Lumian set the carbide lamp down, rolled up his sleeves, and crouched beside the river.
target: Post rapidam inspectionem, Lumian lampadem carbidae deponit, manicas revolvit, et iuxta flumen se procubuit.

source: Without hesitation, he plunged his right arm into the frigid water.
target: Sine mora, dextrum brachium in aquam frigidam immergit.

source: “Is this your preferred method of fishing?” Franca inquired, well aware of Lumian’s penchant for “fishing.” However, she hadn’t anticipated him employing the same technique when his prey was, quite literally, fish.
target: “Estne hoc modus tuus praelatus piscandi?” Franca quaesivit, bene consciens Lumiani amoris piscandi. Attamen, non praevidit eum eandem rationem adhibere, cum praeda eius vere piscis esset.

source: “What alternative do I have?” Lumian chuckled. “Would you prefer I strip down, dive into the underwater caves, and catch them with my bare hands?”
target: “Quid aliud mihi restat?” Lumian subridens quaesivit: “Vel mavis ut me exueam, in speluncas subaquaneas descendeam, et eas manibus nudis caperem?”

source: “That’s not an impossibility,” Franca replied with a playful smile. “It would provide an excellent opportunity to admire your physique.”
target: “Non est impossibile,” Franca respondit cum risu ludico. “Occasio optimus esset ad tuam figuram admirandam.”

source: Ignoring her comment, Lumian focused his spirituality, causing a thin layer of white flames to emanate from his thumb.
target: Neglegens eius commentarium, Lumian spiritualitati suae intendit, et tenuis lamina albae flammae ex pollice eius emanavit.

source: The flames, resistant to the water’s extinguishing effect, took the form of a small knife and carefully sliced his index finger.
target: Flammae, aquae exstinctioni repugnantes, in parvum cultrum vertuntur et diligenter digiti indicis sectionem secaverunt.

source: A single drop of blood seeped out, rapidly dispersing into the surrounding water.
target: Una gutta sanguinis efflata, celeriter in aquam circumstantem dispersa est.

source: The Forth Firefish swimming in the shallows seemed to detect an ominous presence and swiftly retreated from the area where the blood had spread.
target: Piscis Ignifer Forthus, in aquis tenuibus natans, videbatur praesentiam funestam deprehendere et celeriter ab eo loco, ubi sanguis diffusus erat, recedere.

source: Moments later, enormous Furth Firefish, their skin charred and hardened, emerged from the caves along the riverbed.
target: Post paululum, ingentes Piscēs Furth Ignifer, quorum cutis exarserat et durata erat, ex speluncis iuxta ripas fluminis emerguerunt.

source: One particularly swift specimen reached Lumian’s right hand in a flash, its mouth wide open to reveal sharp, gleaming teeth.
target: Unum speciem praecipue celerem in momento ad manum dextram Lumiani pervenit, ore late aperto, qui dentes acutos et nitidos ostendebat.

source: Before it could sink its teeth into his flesh, Lumian’s palm abruptly clenched into a fist.
target: Priusquam dentes in carnem eius infirent, palma Lumiani subito in pugnum concrepuit.

source: Instead of withdrawing, he thrust his hand forward, punching directly into the fish’s gaping maw.
target: Non recedens, manum suam protulit, et directe in os pisci, quod late patebat, pulsavit.

source: With a resounding bang, Lumian grasped the creature’s skull and hauled the colossal Furth fish out of the river.
target: Cum resonans ictu, Lumian calvariam creaturae apprehendit et colossalem piscem Furth e flumine extraxit.

source: Silently, cold and sinister black flames ignited in the river, incinerating Lumian’s blood that had merged with the water.
target: Sine strepitu, frigidae atque nefariae nigrae flammae in flumine accensa sunt, sanguinem Lumiani, qui cum aqua coniunctus erat, incinerantes.

source: It was Jenna.
target: Illa erat Jenna.

source: “We can return now,” Lumian declared, tossing the massive Furth fish to Franca.
target: “Nunc redire possumus,” Lumian dixit, colossalem piscem Furth Francae iactans.

source: As Franca caught the ingredient, freezing it and storing it in her Traveler’s Bag, she appeared lost in thought.
target: Cum Franca ingrediens cepit, eam congelans et in sacculo Viatoris suo reponens, videbatur mente profunda absorpta.

source: Keenly observing her demeanor, Lumian asked, “What’s on your mind?”
target: Eius habitum acute observans, Lumian quaesivit: “Quid tibi in mente est?”

source: Pointing in a specific direction, Franca responded, “I remember that nearby, we entered a unique mirror world and acquired the classic silver mirror that granted Anthony and me access to Fourth Epoch Trier.”
target: Indicans in certum directionem, Franca respondit: “Memini quod prope ingressi sumus in mundum specularum unicum et acceperamus speculum argenteum classicum, quod Antoni et mihi ad Trier Aetatem Quartam accessum dedit.”

source: “Indeed,” Lumian acknowledged, gesturing for Franca to continue.
target: “Revera,” Lumian agnovit, gesticulans Francae ut prosequeretur.

source: Averting her gaze, Franca expressed her thoughts, “I’m contemplating whether we could utilize the mirror world to stage an ambush against Moran Avigny.
target: Abiecto aspectu, Franca cogitationes suas exponens dixit: “Cogito num possimus mundum specularum uti ad insidias contra Moran Avigny componendas.

source: Specifically, I’m referring to the conventional mirror world that interconnects all the mirrors in this world.”
target: Speciatim, refero ad mundum specularum conventionalem, qui omnia specula huius mundi internectit.

source: In the conventional sense, the mirror world functioned more akin to a conceptual amalgamation of doors rather than a tangible realm.
target: In sensu conventionali, mundus specularum potius operabatur ut congeries conceptuum ostiarum quam ut regnum tangibile.

source: It served as an intricate network of passageways linking various mirrors and enigmatic lands.
target: Fungebatur ut rete intricatum itinerum, quod diversa specula et terras arcana coniungit.

source: In essence, if Franca could harness the mirror world and pinpoint the precise location, she could conceal herself behind the mirror frequently used by Moran Avigny and launch an attack the moment her target entered.
target: In essentia, si Franca mundum specularum capere et locum exactum determinare posset, se post speculum, quod a Moran Avigny frequenter adhibetur, celare atque oppugnationem in momento quo meta eius intraret, incipere poterat.

source: “What is it that you truly wish to convey?” Lumian raised his eyebrows.
target: “Quid igitur vere vis exprimere?” Lumian supercilia eleverat.

source: Franca eagerly elaborated, “Considering that a portion of the corruption from Fourth Epoch Trier has seeped into this area, giving rise to unique creatures like Furth Firefish and the extraordinary mirror world we previously explored, is it plausible that within this vast underground expanse, there exists a secluded corner influenced by the corruption of a select few high-level Demoness powers over an extended period?
target: Franca studiosissime elaboravit: “Considerans partem corruptionis ex Aetate Quarta Trier in hanc regionem pervenisse, quae creaturas singulares, ut Piscēs Furth Ignifer, et mundum specularum extraordinarium, quem ante exploravimus, gignit, num in hac vasta subterranea regione angulus reclusus exsistat, a corruptione paucarum potentium Demoness altiorum per longum tempus affectus?

source: Could it be possible for one to traverse through the mirror and enter the mirror world without attaining the status of a demigod Demoness?
target: Num fieri potest ut quis per speculum transgrediatur et in mundum specularum ingrediatur, sine statum semidei Demoness assequendo?

source: After a moment of serious contemplation, Lumian replied, “It’s a possibility.”
target: Post brevissimam meditationem, Lumian respondit: “Possibilis est.”

source: Jenna’s eyes darted around as she suggested, “Could it be the location where you discovered the special mirror? That area must have been corrupted by the power emanating from Fourth Epoch Trier’s mirror world.”
target: Oculi Jenna circum volvens, Franca proposuit: “Num id sit locus quo speculum speciale invenisti? Illa regio certe corrupta est potentia, quae ex mundo specularum Aetate Quarta Trier emanat.”

source: “We can investigate,” Lumian said with a smile. “There’s no need to rush. If it proves unsuccessful, we can bide our time. Once Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristic is transformed into a Sealed Artifact, perhaps we can assume the form of Wraiths and conceal ourselves within the mirror. However, I’m uncertain whether Wraiths possess the ability to navigate the mirror world.”
target: “Investigare possumus,” Lumian cum risu dixit. “Non est opus festinare. Si res infelix erit, tempus exspectare possumus. Cum indolem Beyonder de Hisoka in Artefactum Sigillatum transformatum erit, fortasse formam Wraithum assumere possimus et intra speculum nos celare. Tamen, incertus sum an Wraithes facultatem habeant mundum specularum navigandi.”

source: “Let’s prioritize the search!” Franca declared, retrieving her Mirror World Fragment. She hoped that this item might provide some unique means of detection.
target: “Investigatio praevaleat!” Franca declaravit, fragmentum Mundi Specularum suum recuperans. Sperabat hoc rem aliquam viam detectionis unicam praebiturum esse.

source: Lumian glanced at the fragment and, after a brief contemplation, advised seriously, “Holding the Mirror World Fragment is unlikely to yield any benefit. Instead, take out the Primordial Demoness figurine…”
target: Lumian fragmentum aspexit, et post breve cogitationem serio monuit: “Fragmentum Mundi Specularum tenere vix ullum beneficium afferet; proinde, tolle figurinam Demonissae Primordialis.”
